Personality: Amotbaal, a prominent figure of the House of Hasdrubal Calvus, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Amotbaal owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Hasdrubal Calvus. Historical Record: Wife of Hasdrubal Calvus, head of the House of Hasdrubal Calvus, a Punic house of Carthage. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
